question: Which option should I choose? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). Code does not rule HP trades out: that is your call. facts.event.option_outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after each option, by option key. boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。 ALSO DUE NOW: your run plan (state.run_plan_task says why, and where your current plan is). Settle it first, then decide this question with it in mind. You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). If gap_per_turn > 0, closing it comes first: want Strength/scaling and high-damage cards (AoE for two-part bosses), remove Strikes/Defends that dilute them, smith attacks; state the gap in the summary. A gap of 0 is not a reason to stop adding damage: the estimate's typical error is ~25%. Reply to this question in its own JSON format as asked, with one more field in the same JSON object: "run_plan": {"archetype": "<the deck direction, max 12 words>", "want": [card ids to pick when offered, most important first, max 6], "avoid": [card ids not to take, max 6], "remove": [card ids in the deck to remove first, max 3], "block_target": <number of block cards the deck should hold by the act boss>, "elites": "seek" | "normal" | "avoid", "rest": "heal" | "smith" | "auto", "boss_prep": "<max 30 words: what to have ready for the act boss>", "summary": "<max 40 words: the plan in plain words>"}

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which starting card bundle should I take? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run.

question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

your_run_plan.archetype: Flexible early offense and defense, favoring poison against Matriarch
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Secure reliable poison, efficient block, and impactful upgrades. Use sleeping turns for setup; preserve HP and potions against repeated Strength/Dexterity drains.
your_run_plan.summary: Starter output is inadequate. Prioritize immediate combat improvements, favor poison against Matriarch, and follow actual pack contents and rewards. Take supported elites; remove weak starters after replacements arrive, without targeting a fixed deck size.

construction.reason: No core is established and pack contents are unknown. Poison suits Matriarch's attribute drains, but immediate combat strength takes priority. Complete-core performance remains unknown.
construction.pivot_if: Commit toward P with reliable poison and defensive support; favor S with shiv supply and payoff, D with multiple Footworks, or R after acquiring a discard relic.

run_constraints.requirement: V5没有固定牌数上限。按核心兑现、稀释、伤害/回合、升级替代及过渡存活权衡拿牌、跳牌和删牌；牌数不是目标，也不因达到30张而禁止获取。

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which option should I choose? An option that makes you pick card(s) from your deck is listed once per card (key option:card, e.g. o1:c5); one that takes several cards lists its eligible_cards: then also answer "cards": [card keys]. Code plays the option and the card pick(s). You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）

Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）

question: What should I do at this rest site? Heal, smith a named card (one option per card that can be upgraded, with what the upgrade changes), or another rest action; code plays the action and the card pick. You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Settle it first, then decide this question with it in mind. You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: What should I do at this rest site? Heal, smith a named card (one option per card that can be upgraded, with what the upgrade changes), or another rest action; code plays the action and the card pick. You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Each smith option names its card: code upgrades that card on the next screen without asking again. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。plan_facts.if_option 是本题每个选项之后的 HP 对应的下一只精英和 boss 前血量。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。 ALSO DUE NOW: your run plan (state.run_plan_task says why, and where your current plan is). Settle it first, then decide this question with it in mind. You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). If gap_per_turn > 0, closing it comes first: want Strength/scaling and high-damage cards (AoE for two-part bosses), remove Strikes/Defends that dilute them, smith attacks; state the gap in the summary. A gap of 0 is not a reason to stop adding damage: the estimate's typical error is ~25%. Reply to this question in its own JSON format as asked, with one more field in the same JSON object: "run_plan": {"archetype": "<the deck direction, max 12 words>", "want": [card ids to pick when offered, most important first, max 6], "avoid": [card ids not to take, max 6], "remove": [card ids in the deck to remove first, max 3], "block_target": <number of block cards the deck should hold by the act boss>, "elites": "seek" | "normal" | "avoid", "rest": "heal" | "smith" | "auto", "boss_prep": "<max 30 words: what to have ready for the act boss>", "summary": "<max 40 words: the plan in plain words>"}

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

construction_context.instruction: 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。

question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: What should I do at this rest site? Heal, smith a named card (one option per card that can be upgraded, with what the upgrade changes), or another rest action; code plays the action and the card pick. You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Each smith option names its card: code upgrades that card on the next screen without asking again. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。plan_facts.if_option 是本题每个选项之后的 HP 对应的下一只精英和 boss 前血量。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。 ALSO DUE NOW: your run plan (state.run_plan_task says why, and where your current plan is). Settle it first, then decide this question with it in mind. You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). If gap_per_turn > 0, closing it comes first: want Strength/scaling and high-damage cards (AoE for two-part bosses), remove Strikes/Defends that dilute them, smith attacks; state the gap in the summary. A gap of 0 is not a reason to stop adding damage: the estimate's typical error is ~25%. Reply to this question in its own JSON format as asked, with one more field in the same JSON object: "run_plan": {"archetype": "<the deck direction, max 12 words>", "want": [card ids to pick when offered, most important first, max 6], "avoid": [card ids not to take, max 6], "remove": [card ids in the deck to remove first, max 3], "block_target": <number of block cards the deck should hold by the act boss>, "elites": "seek" | "normal" | "avoid", "rest": "heal" | "smith" | "auto", "boss_prep": "<max 30 words: what to have ready for the act boss>", "summary": "<max 40 words: the plan in plain words>"}

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which option should I choose? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). question: What should I do at this rest site? Heal, smith a named card (one option per card that can be upgraded, with what the upgrade changes), or another rest action; code plays the action and the card pick. You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Each smith option names its card: code upgrades that card on the next screen without asking again. boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.relics_at_start: 开场生效：弹珠袋、意外光滑的石头

your_run_plan.archetype: Poison and Accelerant backed by efficient, scalable defense
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Enter healthy; establish Accelerant during sleep. Preserve replay Defend and reserve potions for danger. Upgrade poison or replay Defend only when healing is unnecessary.
your_run_plan.summary: Keep the safe route. Improve poison supply and efficient block rather than adding unsupported attacks. Reassess healing versus upgrades at the final campfire; remove Strikes after obtaining replacements.

construction.reason: Poison and Accelerant support P, but scalable defense is missing. Skewer adds only +0.12±0.23 DPR with +1.19±0.53 HP loss. Dash and Finisher worsen paired survival and S. Baseline/Skewer Accelerant coverage is 149/149 and 228/228 valid traces; matched startup shifts +0.27±0.29 turns across 33 pairs. Most traces are missing; dilution and complete-core performance remain uncertain.
construction.pivot_if: Favor D if multiple Footworks and efficient block arrive. Consider other directions only after obtaining their actual enablers and payoffs.

rest_site.heal_amount: 21 HP: 21 (30% of max HP, rounded down)

run_constraints.activation: V5: Roy removed the fixed permanent deck-size limit
run_constraints.requirement: V5没有固定牌数上限。按核心兑现、稀释、伤害/回合、升级替代及过渡存活权衡拿牌、跳牌和删牌；牌数不是目标，也不因达到30张而禁止获取。

facts.unknown_value_note: ?(数值未知) marks a number the mod does not expose; the text around it is accurate
facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

build_ranking.limits: 同题同种子逐样本配对；先胜率、再合格S、最后配对掉血。只比较已模拟候选，未模拟选项保留未知；S不是胜率，缺口诊断不参与排序。大脑可偏离，但须说明理由。按需采样：各候选统计用自己的n；配对只用两者共有前缀，较短候选对基准的差不引用基准后续样本。
build_ranking.override: 选择不在best_group时填写ranking_override_reason（25词以内）。商店仅比较首个实际购买/删牌动作，不能将单项排序当整套购物组合收益。

facts.boss_readiness: 当前牌组Boss模拟胜率25%（原始25%）；输局224例，Boss平均剩31%、死亡回合均值8.7；缺口中位：进攻+7.9/回合或防守+21.4有效血；敏感度：DPR+25%→45%，有效血+25%→46%（原始样本线性近似，仅诊断，不能排序；防守缺口未知0例）。

question: TASK: run plan (not an option choice; ignore the {choice, reason} reply format for this one). You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). If gap_per_turn > 0, closing it comes first: want Strength/scaling and high-damage cards (AoE for two-part bosses), remove Strikes/Defends that dilute them, smith attacks; state the gap in the summary. A gap of 0 is not a reason to stop adding damage: the estimate's typical error is ~25%. Reply with JSON only: {"archetype": "<the deck direction, max 12 words>", "want": [card ids to pick when offered, most important first, max 6], "avoid": [card ids not to take, max 6], "remove": [card ids in the deck to remove first, max 3], "block_target": <number of block cards the deck should hold by the act boss>, "elites": "seek" | "normal" | "avoid", "rest": "heal" | "smith" | "auto", "boss_prep": "<max 30 words: what to have ready for the act boss>", "summary": "<max 40 words: the plan in plain words>"}

question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

your_run_plan.summary: No improvements remain before Matriarch: combine poison, Accelerant, and careful blocking. Afterward prioritize scalable defense, draw, and group control. Remove Strikes; preserve replay Defend. Avoid elites until defense improves, then reassess upgrades versus healing at campfires as needed for survival and progression consistently throughout the run ahead.

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which of the Ancient's options should I take, and which route should I follow this act? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

construction.pivot_if: Emphasize D if repeated Footwork and efficient block become available. Consider other directions only after their enabling relics and card supply actually appear.

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which option should I choose? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). Code does not rule HP trades out: that is your call. facts.event.option_outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after each option, by option key. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

在你面前的是一幕颇为宏伟的景象。

你加入其中，表达了你的见解。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。
act_boss_sim.boss_margin_objective: Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.samples: 每个选项 1000 次；所有选项同一组随机种子，按样本配对比较；用时 7.0 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.relics_at_start: 开场生效：弹珠袋、意外光滑的石头、黄金印
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

your_run_plan.boss_prep: Upgrade Accelerant; secure dual-target poison, scalable block, and Malaise. Face the most dangerous crab attack, prepare for Rocket’s laser, and keep potion support.
your_run_plan.summary: Prioritize block and draw purchases, then remove weak starters after replacements. Reserve 90 gold for Gold Seal energy. Upgrade Accelerant when safe; heal before the forced elite and boss. Full-core performance remains unknown.

construction.reason: Existing poison and Accelerant favor P, but scalable defense and draw are missing. Gold Seal supports setup and multiple block cards. Complete-fight performance and dilution effects are unmeasured.
construction.pivot_if: Emphasize D if repeated Footwork and efficient block become available. Consider other directions only after their enabling relics and card supply actually appear.

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.samples: 按需采样：基准n=1000，候选各用自身n，差值仅用共同种子前缀；上限1000；用时 18.1 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.relics_at_start: 开场生效：弹珠袋、意外光滑的石头、黄金印
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

your_run_plan.archetype: Accelerant poison with scalable block, draw, and Gold Seal energy
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Upgrade Accelerant; secure dual-target poison, scalable block, and Malaise. Face the most dangerous crab attack, prepare for Rocket’s laser, and keep potion support.
your_run_plan.summary: Prioritize block and draw purchases, then remove weak starters after replacements. Reserve 90 gold for Gold Seal energy. Upgrade Accelerant when safe; heal before the forced elite and boss. Full-core performance remains unknown.

construction.reason: Existing poison and Accelerant favor P, but scalable defense and draw are missing. Gold Seal supports setup and multiple block cards. Complete-fight performance and dilution effects are unmeasured.
construction.pivot_if: Emphasize D if repeated Footwork and efficient block become available. Consider other directions only after their enabling relics and card supply actually appear.

facts.unknown_value_note: ?(数值未知) marks a number the mod does not expose; the text around it is accurate
facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.relics_at_start: 开场生效：弹珠袋、意外光滑的石头、黄金印
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

your_run_plan.archetype: Accelerant poison with scalable block, draw, and Gold Seal energy
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Upgrade Accelerant; secure dual-target poison, scalable block, and Malaise. Face the most dangerous crab attack, prepare for Rocket’s laser, and keep potion support.
your_run_plan.summary: Prioritize block and draw purchases, then remove weak starters after replacements. Reserve 90 gold for Gold Seal energy. Upgrade Accelerant when safe; heal before the forced elite and boss. Full-core performance remains unknown.

construction.reason: Existing poison and Accelerant favor P, but scalable defense and draw are missing. Gold Seal supports setup and multiple block cards. Complete-fight performance and dilution effects are unmeasured.
construction.pivot_if: Emphasize D if repeated Footwork and efficient block become available. Consider other directions only after their enabling relics and card supply actually appear.

run_constraints.activation: V5: Roy removed the fixed permanent deck-size limit
run_constraints.requirement: V5没有固定牌数上限。按核心兑现、稀释、伤害/回合、升级替代及过渡存活权衡拿牌、跳牌和删牌；牌数不是目标，也不因达到30张而禁止获取。

facts.unknown_value_note: ?(数值未知) marks a number the mod does not expose; the text around it is accurate
facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

build_ranking.limits: 同题同种子逐样本配对；先胜率、再合格S、最后配对掉血。只比较已模拟候选，未模拟选项保留未知；S不是胜率，缺口诊断不参与排序。大脑可偏离，但须说明理由。按需采样：各候选统计用自己的n；配对只用两者共有前缀，较短候选对基准的差不引用基准后续样本。
build_ranking.override: 选择不在best_group时填写ranking_override_reason（25词以内）。商店仅比较首个实际购买/删牌动作，不能将单项排序当整套购物组合收益。

question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

your_run_plan.archetype: Accelerant poison with scalable block, draw, and Gold Seal energy
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Upgrade Accelerant; secure dual-target poison, scalable block, and Malaise. Face the most dangerous crab attack, prepare for Rocket’s laser, and keep potion support.
your_run_plan.summary: Prioritize block and draw purchases, then remove weak starters after replacements. Reserve 90 gold for Gold Seal energy. Upgrade Accelerant when safe; heal before the forced elite and boss. Full-core performance remains unknown.

construction.reason: Existing poison and Accelerant favor P, but scalable defense and draw are missing. Gold Seal supports setup and multiple block cards. Complete-fight performance and dilution effects are unmeasured.
construction.pivot_if: Emphasize D if repeated Footwork and efficient block become available. Consider other directions only after their enabling relics and card supply actually appear.

facts.unknown_value_note: ?(数值未知) marks a number the mod does not expose; the text around it is accurate
facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.entry_hp: 58/70：本幕路线计划到 boss（F33）的中位投影，和 route_review.plan_facts.boss 同一个算法

act_boss_sim.samples: 按需采样：基准n=300，候选各用自身n，差值仅用共同种子前缀；上限1000；用时 43.2 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.relics_at_start: 开场生效：弹珠袋、意外光滑的石头、黄金印
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

your_run_plan.archetype: Accelerant poison with scalable block, draw, and Gold Seal energy
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Upgrade Accelerant; secure dual-target poison, scalable block, and Malaise. Face the most dangerous crab attack, prepare for Rocket’s laser, and keep potion support.
your_run_plan.summary: Prioritize block and draw purchases, then remove weak starters after replacements. Reserve 90 gold for Gold Seal energy. Upgrade Accelerant when safe; heal before the forced elite and boss. Full-core performance remains unknown.

construction.reason: Existing poison and Accelerant favor P, but scalable defense and draw are missing. Gold Seal supports setup and multiple block cards. Complete-fight performance and dilution effects are unmeasured.
construction.pivot_if: Emphasize D if repeated Footwork and efficient block become available. Consider other directions only after their enabling relics and card supply actually appear.

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.relics_at_start: 开场生效：弹珠袋、意外光滑的石头、黄金印、铜质鳞片
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

your_run_plan.archetype: Accelerant poison with scalable block, draw, and Gold Seal energy
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Upgrade Accelerant; secure dual-target poison, scalable block, and Malaise. Face the most dangerous crab attack, prepare for Rocket’s laser, and keep potion support.
your_run_plan.summary: Prioritize block and draw purchases, then remove weak starters after replacements. Reserve 90 gold for Gold Seal energy. Upgrade Accelerant when safe; heal before the forced elite and boss. Full-core performance remains unknown.

construction.reason: Existing poison and Accelerant favor P, but scalable defense and draw are missing. Gold Seal supports setup and multiple block cards. Complete-fight performance and dilution effects are unmeasured.
construction.pivot_if: Emphasize D if repeated Footwork and efficient block become available. Consider other directions only after their enabling relics and card supply actually appear.

facts.unknown_value_note: ?(数值未知) marks a number the mod does not expose; the text around it is accurate
facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。
