question: What should I do at this rest site? Heal, smith a named card (one option per card that can be upgraded, with what the upgrade changes), or another rest action; code plays the action and the card pick. You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Each smith option names its card: code upgrades that card on the next screen without asking again. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。plan_facts.if_option 是本题每个选项之后的 HP 对应的下一只精英和 boss 前血量。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

your_run_plan.summary: Heal now; keep the three-fire shop route. Improve poison throughput, scalable block and draw. Remove weak starters after replacements while preserving Gold Seal fuel. Boss simulations still show major offensive and defensive deficits.

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Plan this whole shop visit in ONE answer: an ordered shopping list that code carries out step by step, re-checking each step against the live shop. Reply with JSON only: {"plan": [<steps in order>], "reason": "<max 40 words>"}. A step is an option key (buy_relicN / buy_cardN / buy_potionN), "remove:<card key>" to pay for the card removal and remove that card (card keys are state.your_cards), or discard_potionN to empty a potion slot first (buying a potion needs an empty slot). Leaving is implied after the last step; [] buys nothing. Unaffordable items are listed as facts (affordable_now false); gold only goes down in a shop, so the whole list must fit your gold at the listed prices (check the sum). act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.entry_hp: 55/70：本幕路线计划到 boss（F33）的中位投影，和 route_review.plan_facts.boss 同一个算法

act_boss_sim.samples: 按需采样：基准n=1000，候选各用自身n，差值仅用共同种子前缀；上限1000；用时 74.8 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.relics_at_start: 开场生效：弹珠袋、意外光滑的石头、黄金印、铜质鳞片
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

your_run_plan.archetype: Accelerant poison with scalable defense and draw
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Upgrade Accelerant when safe; establish poison and sustained block. Preserve replay Defend, Malaise, potion support, and Gold Seal fuel. Face Rocket during its laser.
your_run_plan.summary: Heal now; keep the three-fire shop route. Improve poison throughput, scalable block and draw. Remove weak starters after replacements while preserving Gold Seal fuel. Boss simulations still show major offensive and defensive deficits.

construction.reason: Existing poison and Accelerant favor P. Bubble Bubble adds paired full-fight DPR 1.19±0.23, but margin and HP loss remain indistinguishable. Accelerant use and conditional first-play differences are inconclusive; missing traces leave dilution and complete-core performance unknown.
construction.pivot_if: Emphasize D if repeated Footwork and efficient block appear. Reassess after the shop if poison throughput or setup protection remains inadequate.

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.samples: 按需采样：基准n=1000，候选各用自身n，差值仅用共同种子前缀；上限1000；用时 15.3 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: What should I do at this rest site? Heal, smith a named card (one option per card that can be upgraded, with what the upgrade changes), or another rest action; code plays the action and the card pick. You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Each smith option names its card: code upgrades that card on the next screen without asking again. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。plan_facts.if_option 是本题每个选项之后的 HP 对应的下一只精英和 boss 前血量。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。 ALSO DUE NOW: your run plan (state.run_plan_task says why, and where your current plan is). Settle it first, then decide this question with it in mind. You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). If gap_per_turn > 0, closing it comes first: want Strength/scaling and high-damage cards (AoE for two-part bosses), remove Strikes/Defends that dilute them, smith attacks; state the gap in the summary. A gap of 0 is not a reason to stop adding damage: the estimate's typical error is ~25%. act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.entry_hp: 29/70：本幕路线计划到 boss（F33）的中位投影，和 route_review.plan_facts.boss 同一个算法

act_boss_sim.samples: 按需采样：基准n=300，候选各用自身n，差值仅用共同种子前缀；上限1000；用时 13.7 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.relics_at_start: 开场生效：弹珠袋、意外光滑的石头、黄金印、铜质鳞片
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

your_run_plan.archetype: Accelerant poison with scalable block and gold-funded energy
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Upgrade Accelerant when safe. Protect poison setup with Weak and scalable block; preserve potions and Golden Seal fuel. Face Rocket during its laser.
your_run_plan.summary: Keep the one-elite, two-fire route. Improve poison throughput and scalable defense; replace weak starters without targeting deck size. Heal when depleted, otherwise upgrade Accelerant. Current boss simulations show substantial offensive and survival deficits.

construction.pivot_if: Favor D if multiple Footworks and efficient blocks arrive with adequate damage. Reassess poison priorities if elite combat exposes insufficient supply or setup protection.

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。
act_boss_sim.boss: 帝王蟹，A10：碾碎爪 219 血、火箭 209 血
act_boss_sim.entry_hp: 56/70：本幕路线计划到 boss（F33）的中位投影，和 route_review.plan_facts.boss 同一个算法

act_boss_sim.samples: 按需采样：基准n=1000，候选各用自身n，差值仅用共同种子前缀；上限1000；用时 25.5 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.relics_at_start: 开场生效：弹珠袋、意外光滑的石头、黄金印、铜质鳞片
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.relics_at_start: 开场生效：弹珠袋、意外光滑的石头、黄金印、铜质鳞片
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: What should I do at this rest site? Heal, smith a named card (one option per card that can be upgraded, with what the upgrade changes), or another rest action; code plays the action and the card pick. You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Each smith option names its card: code upgrades that card on the next screen without asking again. boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。

act_boss_sim.samples: 按需采样：基准n=300，候选各用自身n，差值仅用共同种子前缀；上限1000；用时 42.5 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.relics_at_start: 开场生效：弹珠袋、意外光滑的石头、黄金印、铜质鳞片
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: TASK: run plan (not an option choice; ignore the {choice, reason} reply format for this one). You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). If gap_per_turn > 0, closing it comes first: want Strength/scaling and high-damage cards (AoE for two-part bosses), remove Strikes/Defends that dilute them, smith attacks; state the gap in the summary. A gap of 0 is not a reason to stop adding damage: the estimate's typical error is ~25%. Reply with JSON only: {"archetype": "<the deck direction, max 12 words>", "want": [card ids to pick when offered, most important first, max 6], "avoid": [card ids not to take, max 6], "remove": [card ids in the deck to remove first, max 3], "block_target": <number of block cards the deck should hold by the act boss>, "elites": "seek" | "normal" | "avoid", "rest": "heal" | "smith" | "auto", "boss_prep": "<max 30 words: what to have ready for the act boss>", "summary": "<max 40 words: the plan in plain words>"}

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which of the Ancient's options should I take, and which route should I follow this act? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). Code does not rule HP trades out: that is your call. facts.event.option_outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after each option, by option key. 幕初：远古的选项和本幕路线一起定。state.act_route 是本幕完整地图（你在远古节点上，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）。回答 JSON：{"choice": "<选项 key>", "route": "<节点 id，用空格分隔：从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线（或用飞行靴）一直到 boss>", "reason": "<30 字以内>"}（选项列出 eligible_cards 时再加 "cards"）。选项改变 HP、最大生命或金币时写在它的 route_effect 里。代码先执行选项，再按路线逐个节点走，只在路线走不通时再问你；选项结果随机时，揭晓后在第一张地图问一次保留还是换路线；之后的选牌、休息点和事件的最后一问也会附上路线让你保留或修改。state.act_route.candidate_routes 是代码按投影列的几条到 boss 的路线，每段的战斗、精英进场和到达休息点、boss 的 HP（事实，不是选项）。 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。 ALSO DUE NOW: your run plan (state.run_plan_task says why, and where your current plan is). Settle it first, then decide this question with it in mind. You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). If gap_per_turn > 0, closing it comes first: want Strength/scaling and high-damage cards (AoE for two-part bosses), remove Strikes/Defends that dilute them, smith attacks; state the gap in the summary. A gap of 0 is not a reason to stop adding damage: the estimate's typical error is ~25%. Reply to this question in its own JSON format as asked, with one more field in the same JSON object: "run_plan": {"archetype": "<the deck direction, max 12 words>", "want": [card ids to pick when offered, most important first, max 6], "avoid": [card ids not to take, max 6], "remove": [card ids in the deck to remove first, max 3], "block_target": <number of block cards the deck should hold by the act boss>, "elites": "seek" | "normal" | "avoid", "rest": "heal" | "smith" | "auto", "boss_prep": "<max 30 words: what to have ready for the act boss>", "summary": "<max 40 words: the plan in plain words>"}

question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim为F48→F49连续两战原始通关率及配对差，未经两战校准；HP/药水由第一战实际样本传递，全部选项保留，由Codex选择。 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which option should I choose? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). Code does not rule HP trades out: that is your call. facts.event.option_outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after each option, by option key. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim为F48→F49连续两战原始通关率及配对差，未经两战校准；HP/药水由第一战实际样本传递，全部选项保留，由Codex选择。 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim为F48→F49连续两战原始通关率及配对差，未经两战校准；HP/药水由第一战实际样本传递，全部选项保留，由Codex选择。 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

your_run_plan.archetype: Accelerant poison with scalable defense and Crossbow support
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Upgrade Accelerant; establish sustained poison and scalable block. Use Malaise/Wail against dangerous attacks. Preserve HP and potions across both bosses.
your_run_plan.summary: Use three fires and two shops without elites. Prioritize scalable defense, poison throughput, and a safe Accelerant upgrade. Remove Strikes selectively while preserving Golden Seal fuel. Prepare resources for consecutive bosses; the damage gap remains unknown.

construction.reason: Poison, Accelerant, and Funnel support P; sustained defense remains missing. Crossbow supplies recurring free attacks without permanent deck dilution. Complete-core performance and combat estimates are unavailable.
construction.pivot_if: Exploit discard if Bandages or Tingsha appear; consider D after acquiring two Footworks and efficient block. Otherwise retain poison and improve defensive reliability.

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which option should I choose? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). Code does not rule HP trades out: that is your call. facts.event.option_outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after each option, by option key. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。 boss_sim为F48→F49连续两战原始通关率及配对差，未经两战校准；HP/药水由第一战实际样本传递，全部选项保留，由Codex选择。 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Plan this whole shop visit in ONE answer: an ordered shopping list that code carries out step by step, re-checking each step against the live shop. Reply with JSON only: {"plan": [<steps in order>], "reason": "<max 40 words>"}. A step is an option key (buy_relicN / buy_cardN / buy_potionN), "remove:<card key>" to pay for the card removal and remove that card (card keys are state.your_cards), or discard_potionN to empty a potion slot first (buying a potion needs an empty slot). Leaving is implied after the last step; [] buys nothing. Unaffordable items are listed as facts (affordable_now false); gold only goes down in a shop, so the whole list must fit your gold at the listed prices (check the sum). You are asked again only if the shop changes under the plan (an item the plan still buys changes price, is gone or cannot be bought, or new stock appears in a slot the plan did not buy). boss_sim为F48→F49连续两战原始通关率及配对差，未经两战校准；HP/药水由第一战实际样本传递，全部选项保留，由Codex选择。 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。 ALSO DUE NOW: your run plan (state.run_plan_task says why, and where your current plan is). Settle it first, then decide this question with it in mind. You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). If gap_per_turn > 0, closing it comes first: want Strength/scaling and high-damage cards (AoE for two-part bosses), remove Strikes/Defends that dilute them, smith attacks; state the gap in the summary. A gap of 0 is not a reason to stop adding damage: the estimate's typical error is ~25%. Reply to this question in its own JSON format as asked, with one more field in the same JSON object: "run_plan": {"archetype": "<the deck direction, max 12 words>", "want": [card ids to pick when offered, most important first, max 6], "avoid": [card ids not to take, max 6], "remove": [card ids in the deck to remove first, max 3], "block_target": <number of block cards the deck should hold by the act boss>, "elites": "seek" | "normal" | "avoid", "rest": "heal" | "smith" | "auto", "boss_prep": "<max 30 words: what to have ready for the act boss>", "summary": "<max 40 words: the plan in plain words>"}

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。
act_boss_sim.boss: 女王，A10：火炬头聚合体 211 血、女王 419 血
act_boss_sim.entry_hp: 70/70：本幕路线计划到 boss（F48）的中位投影，和 route_review.plan_facts.boss 同一个算法
act_boss_sim.current_deck: 两战原始通关率 0%，1000配对样本；未经两战校准，不是必死或SL判据。
act_boss_sim.samples: 按需采样：基准n=1000，候选各用自身n，差值仅用共同种子前缀；上限1000；用时 140.1 秒
act_boss_sim.method: 第一战获胜的同一条样本继续第二战，没有独立胜率相乘，没有补满HP或补回喝掉的药水；差及标准误均来自两战原始配对结果。
act_boss_sim.limits: 仅4局F49、实际胜0；时间验证2局均败，连续模拟未校准，只作备战和出牌参考，不能判必死或触发SL。HP>60夹在样本边界；其他药水/遗物未建模影响不确定。

your_run_plan.archetype: Accelerant poison with scalable defense and Crossbow support
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Upgrade Accelerant; establish sustained poison and scalable block. Use Malaise/Wail against dangerous attacks. Preserve HP and potions across both bosses.
your_run_plan.summary: Use three fires and two shops without elites. Prioritize scalable defense, poison throughput, and a safe Accelerant upgrade. Remove Strikes selectively while preserving Golden Seal fuel. Prepare resources for consecutive bosses; the damage gap remains unknown.

construction.reason: Poison, Accelerant, and Funnel support P; sustained defense remains missing. Crossbow supplies recurring free attacks without permanent deck dilution. Complete-core performance and combat estimates are unavailable.
construction.pivot_if: Exploit discard if Bandages or Tingsha appear; consider D after acquiring two Footworks and efficient block. Otherwise retain poison and improve defensive reliability.

run_constraints.activation: V5: Roy removed the fixed permanent deck-size limit
run_constraints.requirement: V5没有固定牌数上限。按核心兑现、稀释、伤害/回合、升级替代及过渡存活权衡拿牌、跳牌和删牌；牌数不是目标，也不因达到30张而禁止获取。

double_boss_preparation.objective: 第三幕路线和休息按F48→F49连续两战备战：第一战剩余HP/药水是第二战进场资源，四局观察没有中间营火或回血。
double_boss_preparation.projection: 沿用silent-0163/S1.fix27：F48之后路线血量仍未知，不把进F48的血量当进F49血量；连战模拟才传递每条样本实际余量。
double_boss_preparation.limits: 仅4局F49、实际胜0；时间验证2局均败，连续模拟未校准，只作备战和出牌参考，不能判必死或触发SL。HP>60夹在样本边界；其他药水/遗物未建模影响不确定。
double_boss_preparation.choice: 全部路线、休息和锻造选项保留，由Codex结合即时血量、牌组及连续两战原始模拟选择。

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

answer.reason: Save 170 gold for the upcoming shop and Golden Seal. Snakebite adds modeled damage without demonstrated survival gains; Rolling Boulder exhausts the budget and shortens simulated survival. Neither fixes sustained defense.

run_plan.archetype: Accelerant poison protected by doubled block and Crossbow attacks
run_plan.boss_prep: Heal next; upgrade Accelerant when safe. Add scalable defense and stronger poison. Preserve Golden Seal fuel, HP, and potions across consecutive bosses.
run_plan.summary: Keep the safe three-fire route. Save for the next shop, prioritize scalable defense and poison throughput, upgrade Accelerant safely, and remove Strikes selectively. Prepare for both bosses; the damage gap remains unknown.

construction.reason: Poison, Accelerant, and Funnel support P, but sustained defense remains missing. Snakebite adds 2.72±0.65 modeled DPR; Strike removal shows no clear DPR improvement. Saturated outcomes and incomplete traces leave survival, startup, and complete-core reliability unresolved.
construction.pivot_if: Consider discard after acquiring Tingsha or Bandages, or D after two Footworks. Otherwise retain poison and improve actual defensive setup and throughput.

question: What should I do at this rest site? Heal, smith a named card (one option per card that can be upgraded, with what the upgrade changes), or another rest action; code plays the action and the card pick. You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Each smith option names its card: code upgrades that card on the next screen without asking again. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。plan_facts.if_option 是本题每个选项之后的 HP 对应的下一只精英和 boss 前血量。 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

act_boss_sim.quantitative_uncertainty: 模拟分布不是实际结果；p10–p90是样本结果波动，meanSe是均值的蒙特卡洛误差，不含机制/策略偏差。增加样本不能修复模型偏差；零次/全胜样本不证明必死/必胜。超时完成样本可能有选择偏差，capped是未结束，不能当已败；胜率区间仅指模拟终止前获胜。
act_boss_sim.boss: 女王，A10：火炬头聚合体 211 血、女王 419 血
act_boss_sim.entry_hp: 59/70：本幕路线计划到 boss（F48）的中位投影，和 route_review.plan_facts.boss 同一个算法
act_boss_sim.current_deck: 两战原始通关率 0%，1000配对样本；未经两战校准，不是必死或SL判据。

act_boss_sim.method: 第一战获胜的同一条样本继续第二战，没有独立胜率相乘，没有补满HP或补回喝掉的药水；差及标准误均来自两战原始配对结果。

your_run_plan.archetype: Accelerant poison protected by doubled block and Crossbow attacks
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Heal next; upgrade Accelerant when safe. Add scalable defense and stronger poison. Preserve Golden Seal fuel, HP, and potions across consecutive bosses.
your_run_plan.summary: Keep the safe three-fire route. Save for the next shop, prioritize scalable defense and poison throughput, upgrade Accelerant safely, and remove Strikes selectively. Prepare for both bosses; the damage gap remains unknown.

construction.reason: Poison, Accelerant, and Funnel support P, but sustained defense remains missing. Snakebite adds 2.72±0.65 modeled DPR; Strike removal shows no clear DPR improvement. Saturated outcomes and incomplete traces leave survival, startup, and complete-core reliability unresolved.
construction.pivot_if: Consider discard after acquiring Tingsha or Bandages, or D after two Footworks. Otherwise retain poison and improve actual defensive setup and throughput.

run_constraints.activation: V5: Roy removed the fixed permanent deck-size limit
run_constraints.requirement: V5没有固定牌数上限。按核心兑现、稀释、伤害/回合、升级替代及过渡存活权衡拿牌、跳牌和删牌；牌数不是目标，也不因达到30张而禁止获取。

double_boss_preparation.objective: 第三幕路线和休息按F48→F49连续两战备战：第一战剩余HP/药水是第二战进场资源，四局观察没有中间营火或回血。
double_boss_preparation.projection: 沿用silent-0163/S1.fix27：F48之后路线血量仍未知，不把进F48的血量当进F49血量；连战模拟才传递每条样本实际余量。
double_boss_preparation.limits: 仅4局F49、实际胜0；时间验证2局均败，连续模拟未校准，只作备战和出牌参考，不能判必死或触发SL。HP>60夹在样本边界；其他药水/遗物未建模影响不确定。
double_boss_preparation.choice: 全部路线、休息和锻造选项保留，由Codex结合即时血量、牌组及连续两战原始模拟选择。

Heal, smith a named card (one option per card that can be upgraded, with what the upgrade changes), or another rest action; code plays the action and the card pick. You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Each smith option names its card: code upgrades that card on the next screen without asking again. state.route_review 是本幕路线：完整地图（map，节点 id 规则见 map_legend）、你的位置和下一步可走的节点（next_nodes）、你的路线计划（plan，代码按它逐个节点走）和按现在 HP 算的计划事实（plan_facts）。先定路线，再定本题：在同一个 JSON 里加 "route"："keep"（默认，照计划走）或新的节点序列（从 next_nodes 之一出发，沿连线或用飞行靴，一直到 boss，节点 id 用空格分隔），以及 "route_reason"（15 字以内）。next_rest 是保留（keep，你的计划）和换线（switch，经每个下一步节点）各自到下一个休息点的战斗数和到达 HP、下一只精英的进场 HP：改线前比一比。plan_facts.if_option 是本题每个选项之后的 HP 对应的下一只精英和 boss 前血量。 boss_sim为F48→F49连续两战原始通关率及配对差，未经两战校准；HP/药水由第一战实际样本传递，全部选项保留，由Codex选择。 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。 ALSO DUE NOW: your run plan (state.run_plan_task says why, and where your current plan is). your_run_plan.boss_prep: Heal next; upgrade Accelerant when safe. Add scalable defense and stronger poison. Preserve Golden Seal fuel, HP, and potions across consecutive bosses.
your_run_plan.summary: Keep the safe three-fire route. Save for the next shop, prioritize scalable defense and poison throughput, upgrade Accelerant safely, and remove Strikes selectively. Prepare for both bosses; the damage gap remains unknown.

construction.reason: Poison, Accelerant, and Funnel support P, but sustained defense remains missing. Snakebite adds 2.72±0.65 modeled DPR; Strike removal shows no clear DPR improvement. Saturated outcomes and incomplete traces leave survival, startup, and complete-core reliability unresolved.

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

construction_context.instruction: 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。

question: Which of these card rewards should I take, if any? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. in_deck: copies of that card already in your deck. boss_sim为F48→F49连续两战原始通关率及配对差，未经两战校准；HP/药水由第一战实际样本传递，全部选项保留，由Codex选择。 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

question: Which option should I choose? An option that makes you pick card(s) from your deck is listed once per card (key option:card, e.g. o1:c5); one that takes several cards lists its eligible_cards: then also answer "cards": [card keys]. Code plays the option and the card pick(s). You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). Code does not rule HP trades out: that is your call. facts.event.option_outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after each option, by option key. boss_sim为F48→F49连续两战原始通关率及配对差，未经两战校准；HP/药水由第一战实际样本传递，全部选项保留，由Codex选择。 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。

event.title: 遗忘之墓
event.text:
一座孤冢上[jitter][aqua]翻腾着汹涌的蓝焰[/aqua][/jitter]…

一名高傲的战士战死于此，灵魂却躁动不安。但它渴望继续战斗，你甚至能感觉到它在[sine]哀求[/sine]你带着它一起踏上征途。

但也许，让它直面[red]真相[/red]才是更好的选择？

question: What should I do at this rest site? Heal, smith a named card (one option per card that can be upgraded, with what the upgrade changes), or another rest action; code plays the action and the card pick. You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run.
